**API**
- `_IntervalIndex(batches)` — built once per instrument after `_prepare_groups`. Keeps nonempty batch refs plus first/last `t` only (no copy/sort/concat).
- `_IntervalIndex.slices(start_ns, end_ns)` — `first = bisect_left(last, start)`, `stop = bisect_left(first, end)`, then existing `_bounds` on that range; keeps nonempty `(batch, left, right)`. Cached by exact `(start, end)`. Empty/backwards intervals return `()`.
- `_add_slices(window, index, start_ns, end_ns, counts, *, contribution=True, slice_key='sliced_prints')` — all three call sites (whole, minute, scalar prefix) consume the index and still call `window.add_prepared` for every slice/definition.
- `_collect_scalar_probe` still walks batches with `_bounds`.
- Index lives only inside `check_cohort_unit`; `_release` still owns batches; `indexes.clear()` runs in `finally`. No new output or count fields.
